gaps.what: The 1853 doubling of Cliopatria's shape (about +495,000 km2 after removing the Gulf coast, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Ha'il) is not dated or described by any page; the 1866, 1873, 1885 and 1890 contractions are bridges at confidence 1
Infobox (area, capital names, predecessor fields) lost in the extractor; no area comparison; no ruler strip because the pages give only part of the reigns
How far Ibn Saud's land reached in 1902-1905, the northern frontier lands Cliopatria adds in 1922, the date of al-Jawf, and whether Asir was direct or an Idrisid vassal
When al-Jawf, Tayma and Khaybar became Rashidi, when the Qassim passed to the Rashidis (1877 is Cliopatria's), and who held al-Jawf 1906-1916
Division of the Buraimi oasis (Buraimi and Hamasa to Oman, Al Ain to Abu Dhabi) is undated; no borders of the individual sheikhdoms
Dates of Equatoria and Bahr el Ghazal, the Somali coast beyond Tadjoura, the Sudanese towns Egypt kept after 1885, and the Egyptian desert frontiers 1885-1914

problems: Split of Cliopatria's 'Emirate of Nejd': emirate-of-nejd is now the Second Saudi State only (1824-1891) and the new slug third-saudi-state carries 1902-1926. Dossiers by other groups (asir, kingdom-of-hejaz, and kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd when written) name emirate-of-nejd as the 1920-1925 conqueror and should read third-saudi-state; the colour agent must seed third-saudi-state. Each of the two dossiers shows 'no verdict' warnings for the other's Cliopatria shapes by design.
Counterpart slugs without a dossier or polities.csv row: united-kingdom (eu-11 split), sultanate-of-egypt; also 'emirate-of-harar' exists as a dossier while polities.csv has 'sultanate-of-harar'.

WebFetch's extractor dropped most Wikipedia infoboxes (Emirate of Nejd, Emirate of Riyadh, Sultanate of Nejd, Jabal Shammar, Trucial States): no infobox area exists for four of five states; only the Khedivate (5,000,000 km2) was compared.

Page budget: khedivate-of-egypt opened 3 pages against 1-2 (the third, Emirate of Harar, settled a contradiction: the Khedivate page prints Harar 'in 1866', the Harar page 11 October 1875). A first fetch of 'Saud bin Faisal Al Saud' returned the wrong person (20th-century minister) and was not cited; sources_total counts 25 source entries over 19 distinct pages (pages shared across dossiers are listed in each).

Several states are longer than Cliopatria's rows: trucial-states runs to 1971 (Cliopatria 1894), khedivate-of-egypt to 1914 (Cliopatria 1884), emirate-of-jabal-shammar starts 1836 (Cliopatria 1825); new keyframes cover the gaps. Cliopatria's United Arab Emirates row starts in 1973, leaving 1971-1972 to the trucial-states dossier.
Not resolved by the gazetteer: the islands Abu Musa and the Tunbs resolve to no cells (2 resolve warnings in trucial-states); the other four dossiers resolve fully.
